notes.title: Rollers of the Realm 2 at IndieCup Celebration!
notes.content:
Hey there Realm Rollers!

In 2022, the IndieCup team introduced IndieCup Canada, IndieCup Germany, and IndieCup Ukraine all while [url=https://indiecup.net/ukraine/donate/]bringing support and awareness[/url] to the events occurring in their home country:

[i]"Indie Cup’s team lives in Ukraine. The war forced each of us to change our plans — today we’re not only organizing a contest, but also volunteering, donating money, donating blood, building dugouts and helping our loved ones escape from the war. Some of us cannot return to Ukraine, and some took a break from work to defend our country at the frontlines."[/i] - indiecup.net

We're extremely humbled by their efforts and thankful to be a part of their Steam event. We hope you all get a chance to check out the event page and show a little extra support to the devs from Ukraine. 

Event Page: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38747278/sale/indiecup2023

Thanks,
Phantom Compass team

notes.title: BIG Demo Update: New Ranked Board!
notes.content:
[h2][b][h3][b]Patch Notes for Demo Build 0.13.8862[/b][/h3][/b][/h2]

[h3]Mega Updates! [/h3]
[list]
[*] NEW NEW NEW- Monarch Hall Ranked Board unlocked! You can now go for a highscore on TWO different ranked leaderboards!
[*] Upgrades unlocked! Have fun racking up levels and bedazzling your heroes with new equipment and items to get even higher on the leaderboard (But fair warning that a major rebalance is on the horizon)
[*] Leaderboards and save game have been reset
[/list]
[h3]Other things that we touched to try to make your day a bit better:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jump right into Ranked boards! Use the Ranked tab or button on the main menu to jump right into these competitive boards
[*] King's Monument Ranked Boss Bounty now 10x bigger starting at 1000 points.
[*] Ranked board end now shows your Leaderboard rank without having to go to map
[*] Improvements to the On Screen Controller for greater accessibility
[*] Unlocked locations are more noticeable on the map now, go explore
[*] Removed purchasable “Coin of Continuation”... you get 3 for now, use them wisely.
[*] Party Roster Picker now also available at the start of the level, so you don’t have to go into the roster menu for last minute adjustments
[*] A few more Goals for you to achieve in the demo.. Boop those sheep!
[*] Language is English only for the time being- We are making some dialogue tweaks, so we have turned off other languages, until we have localization locked down!
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Updated
notes.content:
Hey Friends, 
Here are some updates that we have just made to the demo! See you on the leaderboard!

Patch Notes for Demo Build 0.13.8758
[list]
[*] Opening cinematic now includes localized subtitles (placeholder translation).
[*] Optional on-screen controls for players who prefer single-click gameplay.
[*] Video settings added to Options menu.
[*] Revised Market Streets final pinball area layout: now more shots to make and more lanes.
[*] Added a cave shortcut on the Map to get from the City area to King's Monument and back.
[*] Added a Market Streets Ranked booth (ranked play coming soon!)
[*] Updates to Cheapside and Market Streets replay challenges
[*] Added Ranked button to Main Menu and Ranked tab to Map for easier access to Ranked playfields.
[/list]
Also, in case you missed it, here are the last few updates since we last posted.

2022-07-27 - Patch Notes for Demo Build 0.13.8638
[list]
[*] Ranked board now displays the boss bounty in “Goals”
[*] More audio blings, bings and boops
[*] Options now available on the Pause Menu, so you can change controls and audio settings on the fly.
[*] You can now skip splash screens and retain those precious seconds of your life to spend as you please or choose to watch them in full as you nod a silent thanks to the team and funders who made this game possible ;)
[*] A few improved VFX including a more epic death for the Skeleton Summoner, cause if you do kill him, you deserve it!
[/list]

2022-08-10 - Patch Notes for Demo Build 0.13.8687 
[list]
[*] Fewer "clicks" (steps) to enter a playfield. 
[*] Reworked Ranked Leaderboard UI. 
[*] Added a REPLAY button to playfield completion. 
[*] Added a RESET BALL button to Pause Menu in case the ball gets stuck (still a work in progress). 
[*] Improved the Party menu to better communicate how to add/remove Heroes and what the benefits are. 
[*] Mage revisions: Lightning Bolt Ability now inflicts Ranged Damage instead of unique value, Firewall Dash now inflicts Melee Damage over time instead of unique value. 
[*] Party Stat "Unstable" is now called "MP Recovery" -- the amount of MP recovered automatically when using a Hero Ability. 
[*] Options: added slider for camera shake intensity.
[/list]

More improvements and content is on the way!  Stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Demo Build 0.13.8617
notes.content:
We just pushed a small update to the demo!

Patch notes for new build 0.13.8617:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue accessing Leaderboards.
[*] Fixed an issue in Market Streets where a ball lost in the final battle area would not respawn properly.
[*] Added Boss Bounty to Ranked play: defeat the boss and the bounty goes up.
[*] Fixed an issue Fleeing playfields where you'd appear in an unexpected place on the Map.
[*] Ensured all Mysterious Holes are accessible (not blocked by scenery).
[*] Added voice emotes to Kid NPCs in Cheapside.
[/list]
For a full list of past updates, please check out our Trello board here: https://trello.com/c/3wS9NAqD 

I'd also just like to say thank you to everyone who has played the demo and a big thank you to those who have provided feedback and reported bugs.

Have a flippin' good weekend!

notes.title: Patch notes for DEMO build 0.13.0+8504
notes.content:
Hi folks, 

We just pushed our first update post demo launch! Thank you to everyone who reported bugs and communicated feedback. We can't make any promises but we're trying our best to implement what we can. We hope to have a roadmap available to the public so you can see what our future plans are and what we've addressed so far! 

[b]We have updated the following:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added more granular gameplay difficulty/accessibility options (custom flipper health, custom enemy health, custom game speed)
[*]Added controls graphics to options menu
[*]Added option to turn off controller vibration
[*]Updated bug reporting instructions to “~” key
[*]Improved mysterious hole locations to reduce chance the Rogue goes for a swim after exiting
[*]Made the name tag for the Kings Monument Ranked board location visible on the map
[/list]

notes.title: PAX Rising Online
notes.content:
Rollers of the Realm: Reunion will be part of PAX Rising Online! 

We'll be pairing up with our friends at [url=https://www.blahcadepinball.com/]BlahCade Pinball[/url] for a Let's Play stream on twitch.tv/pax where we'll show off some new gameplay and have an in-depth convo about the game's development. 

During the stream at 1pm EDT/ 10am PDT, you can chat with us in our [url=https://discord.gg/RjHvPuFDfs]Discord[/url] or in the PAX community Discord (coming soon).

The PAX Rising showcase focuses on highlighting and celebrating indie games (which we love), and will not only include the showcase but also a Discord-based community event (which we also love!). They did mention an odd assortment of silly games over the course of the Discord event and a possible raining of free game codes!

For the full lineup of games and details, check out their page [url=https://www.paxsite.com/global/en-us/risingonline.html]here[/url]. 

We will also have more news to share but aren't quite ready yet, so stay tuned!
